description: Exercise the metric assertion (WA24): read the node's chain_head_block Prometheus metric once the chain has advanced. Restored after the three gaps that made it unusable were closed — the metrics endpoint now binds where the harness can reach it, the composition records a translated endpoint per node, and a config-less launch says --metrics on the command line. LIVE-UNVERIFIED: still needs a fleet run to confirm the endpoint exposes this series.
